mereli.sensors.utils package¶

Submodules¶

mereli.sensors.utils.propagation module¶

class mereli.sensors.utils.propagation.Propagation[source]¶

Bases: object

Base class for the mathematical models simulating short range signal propagation. This propagation models are used by the sensor step methods to map Euclidean distances and misalignment angles into signal strengths/readings.

plot(max_rad=5, sensor_name=None)[source]¶

Illustrates the polar plot of a sector coverage.

Parameters

  • max_rad (float) – maximum coverage range (to set the limits of the plot)

  • sensor_name (str) – name of the sensor (to be set in the title).

plot_directivity(directions, max_rad=5, sensor_name=None)[source]¶

Illustrates the polar plot with the directivity pattern of all the sectors at once. It only takes into account the losses due to misalignment, the distance attenuation is not depicted in this plot.

Parameters

  • max_rad (float) – maximum coverage range (to set the limits of the plot)

  • sensor_name (str) – name of the sensor (to be set in the title).

class mereli.sensors.utils.propagation.ExpDecayPropagation(rho_att=0.3, phi_att=1)[source]¶

Bases: mereli.sensors.utils.propagation.Propagation

Simplified signal propagation using the exponential decaying of the signal of both radius and phi. Both terms are combined as a product. Formally, the model is expressed as,

\[f(\rho, \alpha) = \exp\left\{\lambda_{\rho}\,\rho - \lambda_{\alpha}\,\alpha^2\right\}\]

where \(\rho\) is the distance and \(\alpha\) is the misalignment.

Parameters

  • rho_att (float) – coefficient tuning the attenuation due to the distance (\(\lambda_{\rho}\)).

  • phi_att (float) – coefficient tuning the attenuation due to the misalignment (\(\lambda_{\alpha}\)).
